shared_elements: arms/limbs rendered in shallow relief against the body
justification: Both are monumental stone works in which shallow relief limbs and features are cut onto a broad, tapering upright mass, and both share the vertical, stacked reading from a wider top to a narrower base. But A is a flat pillar densely covered with multiple registers of small animal and human figures in low relief, whereas B is a single volumetric anthropomorphic statue with a huge head and almost no surface imagery, so the correspondence is generic rather than compositional.
